navigator.job: Own the visual outcome, checkpoint, permissions, resume, and final synthesis.

worker.job: Implement one bounded motion or rendering change and report its mechanical and visual evidence.

coach.job: Reproduce visual feedback and propose one causal task- or harness-level improvement.

gate.job: Independently compare a candidate with the frozen fixture, mechanical checks, permissions, and rollback guardrails.

feedback.observed: The published v32 still lets replacement sheep, especially human SHEEP 06 and SHEEP 07, appear at the UFO drop and then slide in from another location.
feedback.expected: After exact-drop reveal, each incoming sheep must remain there until movement starts and then traverse only its cleared adjacent bridge cells; no previous sheep coordinate may reappear.
feedback.evidence: On the deployed 10-roster asset SHEEP 06 jumped 96.973px in 30ms and SHEEP 07 jumped 134.101px in 35ms. Source tracing found that the outgoing frame and pose at historyIndex equality survived the turnover skip, were delayed into the incoming lifecycle, and interpolated back toward the bridge.
feedback.reproduction: Sample every incoming roster actor for 1.6 seconds after first visibility at both 30fps and 120fps, and reject any non-adjacent visible coordinate or any frame between incoming move start and bridge completion that is not an allowed bridge step.

feedback.observed: The generic frontend-design skill kept being activated even after project-specific motion research had been completed and preserved, adding context without improving the direction.
feedback.expected: Use the preserved green-movement shot contract and measured 700px frames as the motion authority; return to external or generic design guidance only when the project evidence has a named gap.
feedback.evidence: The Obsidian study now contains sourced staging, continuity, typography, timing, rejection, and Gate rules specific to this SVG, while the generic skill contributed no uncovered job in the latest pass.
feedback.reproduction: Inspect the active capability routing and the next motion candidate; frontend-design must not activate, and each motion decision must map to the project shot contract or a measured source defect.

feedback.observed: Several successive turnover fixes improved empty time, endpoint distance, footprint clearance, and bridge speed, but the user still had to identify that the continuous carrier path communicated the wrong identity story.
feedback.expected: For an identity or continuity complaint, inspect the actor lifecycle and adjacent rendered frames before optimizing another coordinate metric; test what story the uninterrupted trajectory communicates.
feedback.evidence: V21, v25, and v26 passed their numeric turnover checks, yet the v26 source still reused one field-slot actor and moved the UFO directly from the outgoing pickup to the incoming drop. The first diagnosis that traced both facts produced the bounded service-cut correction.
feedback.reproduction: For the next actor-identity motion report, require a source lifecycle trace plus pickup-to-next-action frame sequence before proposing a spatial or timing change.

proposals.change_target: shared replacement movement and pose boundary plus deterministic post-reveal continuity checks
proposals.cause: The turnover skip excluded frames strictly inside the outgoing-to-incoming gap but retained the outgoing historyIndex frame at the shared boundary, so its pickup coordinate reappeared after the incoming exact-drop reveal.
proposals.candidate_change: Skip movement and pose frames at historyIndex equality, reject consecutive visible route keyframes farther apart than one cell plus body allowance, reject unplanned replacement coordinates before bridge completion, and inspect 1.6 seconds after every reveal instead of only the first stable frames.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The two strict-boundary changes remove the stale pickup keyframes. Fresh SHEEP 06/07 browser frames proceed exact drop to adjacent bridge only, and 10- plus 28-roster probes at 30fps and 120fps report zero velocity spikes across every actor's 1.6-second post-reveal window.
proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check, then probe all actors in representative and 10-roster SVGs for 1.6 seconds after reveal at 30fps and 120fps and inspect adjacent 700px SHEEP 06/07 frames.
proposals.primary_metric: Zero stale outgoing coordinates, non-adjacent visible sheep jumps, or post-reveal velocity spikes across all incoming roster actors.
proposals.prediction: Removing the shared boundary frame fixes every replacement identity at the common keyframe generator without changing routes, timing, art, or effects.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if any incoming sheep revisits an outgoing pickup coordinate, jumps farther than an adjacent route step, leaves its drop before the UFO body is hidden, changes accepted timing or routing, regresses causal/layout/finale behavior, exceeds 50 seconds, or npm run check fails.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh independent 700px Gate with exact SHEEP 06/07 frames and 1.6-second 30fps/120fps probes for 10- and 28-roster SVGs.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; this is a project-local keyframe-boundary defect.
guardrails: Change the shared lifecycle boundary once; do not patch individual sheep IDs
Preserve the accepted UFO rhythm, exact-drop hold, cleared bridges, art, themes, panel, causal bites, collection, and finale
No new dependency, asset, effect, permission, or publication
Keep v32 as the published rollback point until independent promotion
proposals.rollback: Restore the two strict interior comparisons and the accepted v32 deterministic checks.

proposals.discovery_evidence: Three accepted numeric corrections did not remove the repeated user perception, while one bounded actor-lifecycle and adjacent-frame trace exposed both the reused slot and uninterrupted carrier path without external research or a new capability.
proposals.reproduction: Audit this v27 diagnosis order and its independent Gate: actor lifecycle and adjacent frames must precede the distance/timing assertion, and the accepted product checks must still run afterward.
proposals.primary_metric: The next project-local identity complaint is diagnosed with lifecycle plus adjacent-frame evidence before another coordinate-only fix is proposed.
proposals.prediction: Checking communicated identity before optimizing coordinates will reduce repeated user corrections without increasing the agent roster, permission scope, or research cost.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if the semantic check is subjective without source/frame evidence, duplicates the existing visual Gate without changing diagnosis order, or causes mechanical spatial and timing regressions to be skipped.

proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; keep this diagnosis rule project-scoped until another project independently reproduces the same gap.
